title: A text tidier
description:
Clean up messy text with `String` and `StringBuilder`.

```
Input:  "  the QUICK brown   fox.  it JUMPED!   "
tidy:   "The quick brown fox. It jumped!"
title:  "The Quick Brown Fox. It Jumped!"
count:  6 words, 2 sentences
```
hints: Walk the characters with a `boolean capitalNext = true`; set it again after `.`, `!` or `?`, and use `Character.toUpperCase` on the next letter.
requirements: `tidy` trims, collapses spaces, lower-cases everything and capitalises the first letter of each sentence (after `.`, `!` or `?`).
`title` capitalises every word of the tidy text.
Build results with a `StringBuilder`, not `+=` in a loop.
stretch: Keep words that are all capitals in the input (like `NASA`) as they are.
